title: Evaluation of K-injective cohomology presheaf agrees with derived sections
statement: Let (X, O_X) be a ringed space and let q be any integer. Write Q for localization from complexes of O_X-modules to their derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], I for the functorial K-injective replacement [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-functorial-existence], and A for the underlying abelian-group presheaf functor on module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose P is a functor from D(O_X) to presheaves of abelian groups equipped with a natural isomorphism Q composed with P to I composed with termwise A composed with q-th cohomology. Then for every open U, evaluation of P at U is naturally isomorphic to q-th cohomology of RΓ(U,-) [def-pc-open-module-derived-sections].

source.place: Tag 0BKJ, proof, the K-injective computation of H^q(U,K); Tag 0D60, setup of derived sections

proof.text: Evaluation at U in abelian-group presheaves is exact. Whisker the given natural isomorphism Q followed by P with evaluation and commute evaluation with homology via ShortComplex.homologyFunctorIso. The resulting complex is termwise openModuleSections by its definition [def-pc-open-module-derived-sections].

The functorial replacement I and its natural map from the identity are given by [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-functorial-existence]. That map becomes a natural isomorphism under Q. The unit of the unbounded right derived sections functor is an isomorphism on I(T), since I(T) is K-injective. Using the quotient-to-derived-category comparison, obtain a natural isomorphism between Q followed by derived sections and I followed by termwise sections followed by Q.

Apply cohomology to the preceding isomorphism and use DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors. Compose with the evaluated presentation of P, and descend the natural isomorphism along the localization Q using Localization.liftNatIso. This supplies the claimed natural isomorphism for all derived morphisms.

proof_origin.note: Formal comparison expanding the K-injective computation in Tags 0BKJ and 0D60.
